how_to_apply: Check that you meet the qualification, experience and age limit for your post as on the interview date.
Go on your post's interview date to: H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901.
Report between 09.30 am and 11.00 am. Candidates will not be entertained before or after the scheduled date and time.
Bring your original documents along with one set of self-attested copies, and hand in the photocopies listed below.
Originals to carry: Bio-data, a recent passport-size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and educational and experience certificates.
Photocopies to hand in at the interview:
Date of birth proof: Birth Certificate, School Leaving Certificate or 10th passing certificate
Mark sheet and passing certificate for the final examination
Past employment: experience certificate showing the dates of joining and relieving
Current employment: appointment letter and last pay slip

content_sections.heading: About HBCHRC Punjab
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab is a cancer hospital and research centre at Medicity, New Chandigarh, Mohali. M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. supplies manpower services to the hospital on contract as an outsourcing agency. Anyone selected through this notice is engaged through the agency and deployed at the hospital.

rows.event: Walk-in: Scientific Officer (IT - Coordinator), Network Administrator
Walk-in: IT Assistant (Networking), Desktop Support Engineer

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview. If too many candidates turn up, an MCQ test will be held and the eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on it. The agency may set a minimum eligibility standard or benchmark and cut-off marks (by group, stream, discipline or category) and may limit the number of candidates called for a written test, interview or skill test. It can base this on factors such as the number of vacancies, marks in graduation or post-graduation, and the applicants' qualifications and experience. Meeting the prescribed qualifications alone does not entitle a candidate to be called for a test or interview. The competent authority's decision is final, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Each post is initially for a fixed tenure of one year from the date of joining. The tenure may be extended depending on satisfactory performance and institutional requirement. Selected candidates will be posted at New Chandigarh or Sangrur, as the institution requires. The engagement is on contract through M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or hidden any material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming comes to light after appointment, the services can be terminated immediately. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. Which posts are interviewed on which day?
faq.answer: Scientific Officer (IT - Coordinator) and Network Administrator are interviewed on 16 November 2026. IT Assistant (Networking) and Desktop Support Engineer are interviewed on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: At the H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901.

faq.question: Q3. Who is the employer for these posts?
faq.answer: M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. engages the candidates. It is an outsourcing agency that supplies manpower to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab on contract.

faq.question: Q4. Where will selected candidates work?
faq.answer: At New Chandigarh or Sangrur, depending on the institution's requirement.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: It starts as a fixed one-year tenure from the date of joining and may be extended if performance is satisfactory and the institution needs it.

faq.question: Q6. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if a large number of candidates turn up. In that case an MCQ test will decide who is shortlisted for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is CCNA required for the IT Assistant (Networking) and Desktop Support Engineer posts?
faq.answer: No. CCNA is a preference for both posts. For both posts, familiarity with TCPIP and IP networking is mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. Can reserved-category candidates get age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST/OBC candidates get relaxation in the upper age limit as per Government of India instructions. Age is counted on the interview date.

faq.question: Q9. What proof of date of birth is accepted?
faq.answer: A Birth Certificate, School Leaving Certificate or 10th passing certificate.

faq.question: Q10. What should a currently employed candidate bring as proof of experience?
faq.answer: A copy of the appointment letter and the last pay slip. For past jobs, bring experience certificates that show the dates of joining and relieving.
